method: Analyst-defined before model runs. Read model answers against the supplied code; do not treat another model as ground truth.
replay: Identify that the deterministic-report exception accepts different repository/artifact contexts when artifact digests differ; a digest difference alone does not bind the report to the same repository/artifact.
Distinguish deterministic control-report reuse from other subject replay and same-context payload conflicts.
Preserve independent Trust level and report-only replay interpretation; do not propose clearing history or enabling blocking implicitly.
candidate: Identify candidate/non-normative/review-only state; do not demand immediate promotion or claim approval.
Distinguish review mappings from active control/policy/evidence/baseline derivation; require separate authority before the latter.
Treat coverage as preliminary design mapping, not consumer compliance or production evidence.
publication: Identify scoped branch/PR publication with no automatic approval or merge.
Identify allowlists, append-only history protection and ancestry checks.
Distinguish a checked-in desired ruleset from evidence of active GitHub protection; distinguish required checks from independent approval.
global_failures: Claims tests executed despite no tools
Claims unsupported content as verified fact
limits: Three selected packets, one run per model and case, no repetitions or blinding. This is a smoke comparison, not a statistical benchmark or full PR review.
